name: Design D: the globe as a page of the Montana Hail Watch website
status: research design only; nothing built, deployed or shipped; no other repo file changed
basis: main-architecture.json (main_head 349df2a; branch merged with main at 195d68c per supervisor-log). Phone floor 288 px per the brief; DESIGN.md:29-30 says 320 px.
summary: A fifth page, globe.html, generated by build.py from the same 10-minute build (no second job), with one vendored WebGL2 library (recommended three.js 0.186.1, 2,120,885 B raw), a hand-written loader capped at 600 lines and 40,000 B, and site-only data: Earth texture, Montana-box basemap raster, terrain field, GOES Band 13 and ACHA2KMC frames, MRMS 11-level crop at 20/35/50 dBZ. It keeps today's rules: site files only, pinned vendored code, a text List for every value, states loaded/problem/stale, the 25-minute banner and the disclaimer. Google-Earth detail needs streamed tiles (D-G1) or hosting the site cannot carry.
rules_applied: Browser fetches only site files: test_site.py:459-471 (regex line 464); map.js:9. Relaxing this is D-G1.
Third-party code vendored and pinned with its licence file, never a CDN: AGENTS.md rule 4; main-architecture constraints (Leaflet 1.9.4 pattern, map.html:14).
Hand-written JS only for browser-only work, documented, no framework: AGENTS.md rule 4; DESIGN.md:26-30.
Evidence honesty: observation, satellite estimate, radar estimate and official alert never merged; no damage, insurance or probability; no echo is not clear (AGENTS.md rule 5; DESIGN.md:275-276).
Alerts reuse the existing alert object; no AI text (AGENTS.md rule 6; build.py:411-414). Each new feed gets a CONTRACTS entry (sources.py:45-138) and a live content check (AGENTS.md rule 7).
Real-browser checks (AGENTS.md rule 8); no best claims (rule 9).
One publisher: build.py:375-379 rebuilds _site from empty; website.yml:155-159 publishes that run only. Fourteen towns only (towns.json; main-architecture what_the_globe_plan_must_change item 10).

s2_library_and_javascript.recommendation: three.js 0.186.1 for all phases. With no tile server, MapLibre's tile and vector strengths go unused, while phases 2 and 3 need height displacement and volumes, which three.js has. Cost: about 0.5 MB more than MapLibre 6.14.0 mjs+worker. If D-G1 allows streamed tiles, re-judge.
s2_library_and_javascript.slow_link_arithmetic: Assumed 1.6 Mbit/s = 200,000 B/s (assumption; no client rate measured). Raw bytes / 200,000 B/s: three.js 2,120,885 -> 10.6 s; MapLibre 6.14 mjs+worker 1,587,206 -> 7.9 s; globe.gl 1,885,160 -> 9.4 s; deck.gl 2,073,497 -> 10.4 s; Cesium 11,494,510 -> 57.5 s. Measured gzip-9 ratios: Cesium 1,773,186/6,080,574 = 0.292; deck.gl 0.277. Applied to three.js: about 0.62 MB (computed estimate; Pages compression not verified).

duties_in_browser: 1 WebGL2 check and text fallback (GPU context).
2 Fetch data/globe.json and images from site paths only, with timeouts and per-source failure states (viewer network).
3 Build sphere, Earth texture, basemap patch and cloud drape (GPU objects).
4 Swap textures and toggle layers (browser input).
5 Phase 2: displace the cloud drape by the height PNG in a vertex shader (GPU).
6 Orbit, zoom, tilt limits, reset (pointer and touch).
7 Project town lat/lon to screen; hide overlapping labels (live camera).
8 Keyboard focus order and aria-pressed (browser events; map.js key handling).
9 Page-age check against the viewer clock (base.html:47-62 precedent).
10 Stale and problem classes from valid times against the viewer clock.
11 Hash state for layer and view (map.js:221-246 precedent).
12 No automatic rotation under reduced motion (matchMedia).
14 Phase 3 only: upload the Python-built 3D texture; run the raymarch shader (GPU).
15 Phase 4 only: step frames; skip failed frames (map.js:1386-1426 precedent).
s2_library_and_javascript.not_in_javascript: Thresholds, dBZ codes, -99/-999 mapping, unit conversion, parallax correction and wording, below-ground masking, freshness limits, palettes (Python writes PNGs), legends, the List, town positions, alert matching. The height PNG is sampled by the vertex shader with a sidecar scale: no CPU elevation decode.

products.what: Static Earth texture, one JPEG, copied each build (build.py:379). NASA Blue Marble, not chosen (s4). Bytes unmeasured; budget 400,000 B (2048 x 1024 px assumed). Built once by hand.
Montana-box raster drawn from basemap.json (384,594 B; budget 450,000 B: test_basemap.py:37, 139-140). Budget 150,000 B proposed; built once by hand.

Frame-box height field on a 0.05 deg grid: 150 x 350 = 52,500 cells = 105,000 B as uint16 (computed). Source USGS 3DEP, public domain with credit requested (joerd attribution quote, terrain.json); Terrarium tiles send ACAO * on GET (terrain.json); 3DEP 951.596 m reproduced at Billings. PNG unmeasured; budget 150,000 B. Built once by hand; not Cesium World Terrain (ion ToS 2.2.2).

GOES Band 13 (10.33 um; brightness temperature in K) crop of the frame box, 8-bit, one frame per build. NOAA ABI-L2-CMIPC on AWS. GOES-West primary (parallax.json nearest-satellite result for Missoula, Billings, Glasgow). Measured 31,885 B per step for the band-13 8-bit crop plus the ACHA 10 km crop (pipeline-options.json per_step_bytes); budget 50,000 B. Latency: upload minus scan end, GOES-19 median 30.2 s (26.1-46.1), GOES-18 median 32.8 s (goes-aws.json).

Cloud-top height: ACHA2KMC 2 km crop as 8-bit PNG at 100 m steps plus sidecar JSON (scale, valid time, DQF rule, datum). From 2023-03-24. Full CONUS object 4.4-4.5 MB per 5-min step (goes-aws.json). Box 417 x 667 px = 278,139 cells (computed); PNG unmeasured; budget 200,000 B. Latency median 117.8 s (GOES-19). Quantisation at most 50 m (computed). Datum: geopotential, about sea level (prototype-goes.json acha_height).

MRMS MergedReflectivityQC crop: 11 levels (0.5-15 km MSL), thresholds 20/35/50 dBZ, native cells, no interpolation (prototype-mrms.json fixtures). Whole gzipped file per level, no byte range (gridded.py:456, 679). Downloaded: 6,424,019 B (prototype R1, quiet step); 6,997,245 B (02:04:39, computed); event step 10,509,537 B (pipeline-options.json). Written: peak 835,879 B per frame at 33 levels, 20 dBZ (measured); budget 1,000,000 B. Decode 0.554 s CPU per level; 11 levels 7.3 s wall.
Fourteen towns from towns.json, labels as DOM text, inside globe.json. Alerts: the existing alert object (build.py:411-414), no new request; map.json is 47,940 B measured.

legends.text: Satellite infrared brightness temperature, K. An observation. Not a height and not a hail signal.
Cloud top height above sea level, km. Satellite estimate (ACHA retrieval). Cloud top only; cloud base is not observed. (rendering-options.json legend_rules)

Not corrected for cloud-top height. The cloud top is drawn where the satellite's ground grid puts it, away from the satellite (north-west or north-east of Montana): about 3 to 4 km off for a 2 km top, about 20 to 33 km off for a 12 to 15 km top. (parallax.json ui_legend_uncorrected_phase1)
Corrected for cloud-top height. The height is a satellite estimate; an error of 1 km in it moves the cloud by about 2 km. (parallax.json ui_legend_corrected_phase2)

Radar echo strength (dBZ). NOAA radar estimate (MRMS), not observed hail or damage. No echo is not clear; 'No radar data' is not clear either. Heights above sea level; levels below the ground surface are not drawn. 20, 35 and 50 dBZ are echo thresholds, not probabilities. (rendering-options.json legend_rules)
Default 1x. When exaggerated, Heights x3 shows on screen (supervisor-log P4: cells read as flat blobs at 1x).

rules: No severity colour ramps; opacity encodes echo class only; every hazard colour carries its word (rendering-options legend_rules).
Hail size (MESH) stays off until its units are verified: mrms.json lists them as unverified ('mm likely').

Kinds stay apart in legend and List: satellite observation (Band 13), satellite estimate (ACHA), radar estimate (MRMS), official alert (NWS), base map (no evidence kind). New kinds need a DECISIONS entry (supervisor-log).

ACHA and MRMS heights are both sea-level referenced (prototype-goes.json; mrms.json heightAboveSea). Ground height comes from the terrain field. Each 1 km of ground elevation adds 1.6 to 2.2 km to the parallax shift (parallax.json conclusion).
No interpolation between frames or levels; each drawn cell is a native value with its footprint (rendering-options failure_modes).
Below-ground levels are not drawn and the List counts them. Billings: terrain 952 m puts MRMS 0.5 and 0.75 km below ground (rendering-options; Montana-wide share unverified).

relaxations_toward_google_earth: R1 (= D-G1): stream imagery tiles. The only route to street-level detail: USGS imagery at LOD 16 is about 1.63 m at Missoula, against 1 km for a hand-built Montana orthoimage (0.47 MP, computed).

R2: host a Montana-wide 10 m orthoimage or 30 m terrain on the site: 4,727 MP at 10 m and about 525 MP at 30 m for the MT box (computed). Even 500 m terrain is 5.25 M cells, 10.5 MB as uint16 (computed), over the terrain budget.

R3: 3D buildings and roof detail: no site-usable source verified. Overture (ODbL) and Microsoft (CDLA-Permissive-2.0) footprints conflict in montana-imagery-buildings.json; roof imagery is a product decision.
R4: Cesium World Terrain with an ion account: not hostable (ion ToS 2.2.2: no offline copy; display during the term only), and it needs an account the site does not use.
R5: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles: excluded by 3.2.3(e) and the no-caching rule; no relaxation of this site's rules fixes it.

R6 (O-10): a second job or external store for the loop. This lifts the 15-minute and single-publisher limits, at the cost of the Actions terms question (O-7) or a host (hosting-options.json option B: Cloudflare R2, 10 GB free, no egress charge).
R7: full-rate 2-minute volumes for 33 levels on phones: 835,879 B per frame at peak and a high GPU class (rendering-options phase_5).
